_meta.purpose: STYLE-FIRST pipeline routing. Every video picks its style(s) FIRST, then this registry routes to the tool+skill. Permanent fix for default-tool bias across all 16+ channels.
_meta.rule: STYLE FIRST, TOOL SECOND. No component gets built without checking this registry + preflight_arsenal.py --live.
